guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：原子干涉重力儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Atomic-interferometer gravimeters
guides.concept: 以銣-87 自由落體原子干涉重力儀為對象，從 π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列與相位 Δφ = k_eff·g·T² 出發，建置啁啾讀出、雷射與真空系統、反射鏡隔振與傾斜控制，再以 k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐校正建立誤差預算，最後透過古典加速度計混合與落體式重力儀比對完成微伽等級的驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Taking a rubidium-87 free-fall atom-interferometer gravimeter as the object, this course starts from the π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence and the phase Δφ = k_eff·g·T², builds the chirp readout, laser and vacuum systems, mirror vibration isolation and tilt control, establishes an error budget through k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tidal corrections, and closes with classical-accelerometer hybridization and comparison against a free-fall gravimeter for microgal-level acceptance.
procedure: 一團冷銣原子在真空中自由落下，三個相隔 T 的雙光子拉曼脈衝扮演物質波的分束器、反射鏡與合束器：第一個 π/2 脈衝把原子分成兩條動量相差 ħk_eff 的路徑，π 脈衝交換兩路，最後的 π/2 脈衝讓它們干涉，干涉結果表現為兩個超精細基態的布居比例。每次脈衝都把雷射相位印在原子上，而雷射相位隨原子位置變化，於是兩條路徑的相位差正比於原子在三個時刻的位置，即 Δφ = k_eff·g·T²。重力儀的「尺」是雷射波長、「鐘」是 T，兩者都可溯源到原子或頻率標準，所以量測是絕對的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

原子落下時相對於拉曼光的都卜勒頻移以 k_eff·g/(2π) 的速率線性增加，若雙光子頻率差不跟著變，三個脈衝就會相繼失諧。因此兩束拉曼光的頻率差以速率 α 線性啁啾，總相位變為 Δφ = (k_eff·g − 2πα)·T²。掃描 α 並在不同 T 下記錄條紋，所有 T 的條紋在 α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) 處交於同一點，此點與 T 無關，直接給出 g = 2πα₀/k_eff；這個「中心條紋」法把重力量測變成頻率量測，準確度取決於產生啁啾的直接數位合成器所用的參考振盪器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「拉曼頻率啁啾 α 與條紋讀出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射系統要提供冷卻光（鎖在 D2 線 F = 2→3' 附近）、回泵光（F = 1→2'）與兩束相位鎖定、頻率相差銣-87 超精細分裂 6.834 GHz 的拉曼光；拉曼光對激發態失諧約 1 GHz，以避免自發輻射。它們常由 1560 nm 光纖雷射倍頻或 780 nm 二極體雷射放大產生，並以飽和吸收穩頻。真空腔是鈦合金或玻璃腔，2D 磁光阱以高通量送原子進 3D 磁光阱，每 0.5 s 裝載約 10⁸ 個原子後釋放約 10⁵–10⁶ 個進入干涉；偵測在落體底部以共振螢光分別讀出 F = 1 與 F = 2 的原子數，取比值得到躍遷機率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「780 nm 拉曼雷射與 6.834 GHz 鎖相」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

原子感受到的雷射相位是由把拉曼光反射回來的那面鏡子定義的，因此那面鏡子才是重力儀的慣性參考：鏡子的任何加速度都與 g 無法區分，鏡子的傾斜則使量到的是 g 在光束方向的投影。工程上把鏡子放在被動（彈簧—質量，約 0.5 Hz）或主動（地震計回授）隔振平台上，並用傾斜計把拉曼光束對準鉛垂線；鏡面本身的平整度與拉曼光的波前像差也會轉成相位，因為原子雲在三個脈衝時看到光束的不同區域。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「拉曼反射鏡、隔振平台與傾斜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

許多系統相位與 k_eff 的方向無關（交流史塔克光位移、二階季曼位移、射頻相位），而重力相位會隨 k_eff 反號；交替使用 +k_eff 與 −k_eff 兩組拉曼躍遷並取差，就能消去這類項。與方向有關的則需個別評估：地球自轉的科氏力把原子雲的水平速度轉成垂直假加速度；地球潮汐讓 g 以半日週期變化上百微伽，必須用潮汐模型修正或作為儀器正確性的檢驗；大氣壓力與極移也各有 µGal 級貢獻。這些修正讓重力儀從「穩定」走向「準確」。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「k 向量反轉、科氏力與潮汐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

重力儀有兩張預算表。靈敏度表列出每次量測的相位雜訊來源：量子投影雜訊（由原子數與條紋對比決定）、殘餘振動、偵測雜訊、拉曼雷射相位雜訊；合成後除以比例因子得到每次量測的 µGal 數，再除以重複率的平方根得到每 √Hz 的靈敏度，最後隨 √τ 平均。準確度表列出不隨平均縮小的偏差：科氏、波前像差、雙光子光位移、二階季曼、傾斜、儀器自重力與參考高度修正；每項以估計值加不確定度列出，均方根合成即儀器的準確度。兩張表分開看，才不會把「穩定」誤當「準確」。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「每次量測雜訊預算與系統偏差表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

原子干涉儀對反射鏡加速度的響應由靈敏度函數描述：在 0 到 1/(2T) 附近最敏感，更高頻率被平均掉。整合時在反射鏡上安裝低雜訊古典加速度計，記錄每次量測期間的加速度 a(t)，以靈敏度函數加權積分得到振動引起的相位，再從干涉相位中扣除或用來即時選擇讀出條紋；這種混合法把隔振平台的需求降低一個數量級，並讓儀器能在沒有安靜地基的野外工作。時序控制器以微秒精度排程裝載、釋放、三個脈衝與偵測，並把所有類比訊號同步記錄，以便事後追溯任何一次量測的狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「古典加速度計混合與序列時序」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

絕對重力儀的驗證方式是與另一台原理不同的絕對儀器在同一點比對：落體式雷射干涉重力儀（如 FG5 型）用角隅稜鏡自由落體與雷射干涉量 g，兩者共享的只有地球本身。比對前要把兩台儀器的參考高度換算到同一點（垂直梯度約 −3 µGal/cm），並施加相同的潮汐、氣壓與極移修正；結果以差值與 En 值表示。國際絕對重力儀比對（ICAG）提供更大規模的驗證。交接文件包含所有偏差表、調垂與波前量測紀錄、頻率參考校正證書、以及每次搬運後的重新驗證程序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「與落體式重力儀比對及 En 值」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A cloud of cold rubidium atoms falls freely in vacuum while three two-photon Raman pulses separated by T act as beam splitter, mirror and recombiner for the matter wave: the first π/2 pulse splits the atoms into two paths differing in momentum by ħk_eff, the π pulse swaps them, and the final π/2 pulse makes them interfere, the outcome appearing as the population ratio of the two hyperfine ground states. Each pulse imprints the laser phase on the atoms, and that phase varies with atom position, so the path phase difference is proportional to the atom positions at the three instants, Δφ = k_eff·g·T². The gravimeter's ruler is the laser wavelength and its clock is T, both traceable to atomic or frequency standards, which makes the measurement absolute. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

As the atoms fall, their Doppler shift relative to the Raman light grows linearly at k_eff·g/(2π), and unless the two-photon frequency difference follows, the three pulses go progressively off resonance. The Raman frequency difference is therefore chirped linearly at rate α, and the total phase becomes Δφ = (k_eff·g − 2πα)·T². Scanning α and recording fringes at several T, all fringes cross at one point α₀ = k_eff·g/(2π) that is independent of T, giving g = 2πα₀/k_eff directly; this central-fringe method turns a gravity measurement into a frequency measurement whose accuracy rests on the reference oscillator feeding the direct digital synthesizer that produces the chirp. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Raman frequency chirp α and fringe readout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The laser system must provide cooling light (locked near the D2 F = 2→3' line), repump light (F = 1→2') and two phase-locked Raman beams whose frequencies differ by the rubidium-87 hyperfine splitting of 6.834 GHz, detuned about 1 GHz from the excited state to avoid spontaneous emission. They are typically produced by frequency-doubling 1560 nm fibre lasers or by amplified 780 nm diode lasers, and stabilised by saturated absorption. The vacuum chamber is a titanium-alloy or glass cell; a 2D MOT feeds a 3D MOT at high flux, loading about 10⁸ atoms every 0.5 s and releasing 10⁵–10⁶ into the interferometer; detection at the bottom of the fall reads the F = 1 and F = 2 populations by resonant fluorescence and takes their ratio as the transition probability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “780 nm Raman lasers with the 6.834 GHz phase lock”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The laser phase the atoms feel is defined by the mirror that retro-reflects the Raman light, so that mirror is the gravimeter's inertial reference: any acceleration of the mirror is indistinguishable from g, and any tilt makes the measurement the projection of g onto the beam direction. Engineering places the mirror on a passive (spring–mass, about 0.5 Hz) or active (seismometer-feedback) isolation platform and aligns the Raman beam to the local vertical with tiltmeters; the mirror's flatness and the wavefront aberration of the Raman beam also turn into phase, because the cloud samples different regions of the beam at the three pulses. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Raman mirror, isolation platform and tilt”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Many systematic phases are independent of the direction of k_eff (AC Stark light shifts, second-order Zeeman shift, RF phases) while the gravity phase changes sign with k_eff; alternating +k_eff and −k_eff Raman transitions and taking the difference cancels such terms. Direction-dependent effects must be evaluated individually: the Coriolis force from Earth's rotation converts the cloud's horizontal velocity into a false vertical acceleration; Earth tides change g by more than a hundred microgals with a semidiurnal period and must be corrected with a tidal model or used as a check of the instrument; atmospheric pressure and polar motion each contribute at the microgal level too. These corrections move the gravimeter from stable to accurate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “k-vector reversal, Coriolis and tides”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A gravimeter carries two budget tables. The sensitivity table lists per-shot phase-noise sources: quantum projection noise (set by atom number and fringe contrast), residual vibration, detection noise and Raman-laser phase noise; their combination divided by the scale factor gives microgals per shot, dividing by the square root of the repetition rate gives the sensitivity per √Hz, and the result averages down as √τ. The accuracy table lists biases that do not average away: Coriolis, wavefront aberration, two-photon light shift, second-order Zeeman, tilt, instrument self-gravity and the reference-height correction; each is listed as an estimate with an uncertainty, and their root-sum-square is the instrument's accuracy. Keeping the tables separate prevents mistaking stable for accurate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Per-shot noise budget and systematic-bias table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An atom interferometer's response to mirror acceleration is described by a sensitivity function that peaks from 0 to about 1/(2T) and averages out higher frequencies. Integration mounts a low-noise classical accelerometer on the mirror, records the acceleration a(t) during each shot, integrates it weighted by the sensitivity function to obtain the vibration-induced phase, and subtracts it from the interferometer phase or uses it to choose the fringe readout in real time; this hybrid method relaxes the isolation platform by an order of magnitude and lets the instrument work in the field without a quiet foundation. A timing controller schedules loading, release, the three pulses and detection with microsecond precision and records every analogue signal synchronously so that the state of any shot can be traced afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Classical-accelerometer hybridization and sequence timing”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An absolute gravimeter is validated by comparison with an absolute instrument of different principle at the same point: a free-fall laser-interferometer gravimeter (such as the FG5 type) measures g from a falling corner cube and laser interferometry, and the only thing the two share is the Earth itself. Before comparison the reference heights of both instruments are transferred to one point (vertical gradient about −3 µGal/cm) and identical tidal, pressure and polar-motion corrections are applied; the result is reported as a difference with an En value. International comparisons of absolute gravimeters (ICAG) provide validation at larger scale. The handoff file contains every bias table, levelling and wavefront records, the frequency-reference calibration certificate and the re-verification procedure after each transport. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Comparison with a free-fall gravimeter and En value”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 拉曼光束未真正反向傳播（同向傳播的拉曼躍遷），k_eff 退化為兩束的波向量差而近乎為零，原子對重力幾乎不敏感，儀器輸出看似穩定卻與 g 無關。
只用單一 k_eff 方向量測，拉曼光功率隨溫度變化使交流史塔克位移漂移，重力讀值出現 20 µGal 的日變化，被誤判為地下水位變動。
pitfallsEn: If the Raman beams are not truly counter-propagating (co-propagating Raman transition), k_eff collapses to the near-zero difference of the two wavevectors, the atoms become almost insensitive to gravity, and the output looks stable but has nothing to do with g.

Measuring with a single k_eff direction lets the AC Stark shift drift as Raman power follows temperature, the gravity reading shows a 20 µGal daily variation, and it is misread as groundwater-level change.

related.difference: 本課聚焦拉曼脈衝原子干涉、k_eff·g·T² 相位與微伽等級的絕對重力量測工程；光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統則以鍶光晶格鐘的超高真空、冷卻與鐘雷射、系統位移與 10⁻¹⁸ 級評估為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on raman-pulse atom interferometry, the k_eff·g·T² phase and microgal-level absolute-gravity engineering; Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems centres on ultrahigh vacuum, cooling and clock lasers, systematic shifts and 10⁻¹⁸-level evaluation of a strontium lattice clock, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 原子干涉重力儀
history.text: 1991 年 Kasevich 與朱棣文在史丹佛大學以受激拉曼躍遷實現第一台光脈衝原子干涉儀並量到重力，1999–2001 年 Peters、Chung 與朱棣文把準確度推到約 3 µGal，與落體式重力儀相當。2000 年代起法國 LNE-SYRTE、德國洪堡大學（GAIN）與中國的研究團隊發展可運輸的冷原子重力儀並參與國際絕對重力儀比對；2016–2018 年間源自 SYRTE 的 Muquans（現屬 Exail）推出商用絕對量子重力儀，應用於大地測量、火山與水文監測。本課只重建公開文獻中的原理與工程方法，不涉及任何產品的專有設計。
history.textEn: In 1991 Kasevich and Chu at Stanford University realised the first light-pulse atom interferometer using stimulated Raman transitions and measured gravity with it, and between 1999 and 2001 Peters, Chung and Chu pushed the accuracy to about 3 µGal, on a par with free-fall gravimeters. From the 2000s groups at LNE-SYRTE in France, Humboldt University in Germany (GAIN) and in China developed transportable cold-atom gravimeters and joined international comparisons of absolute gravimeters; between 2016 and 2018 the SYRTE spin-off Muquans (now part of Exail) introduced a commercial absolute quantum gravimeter used in geodesy, volcano and hydrology monitoring. This course reconstructs only principles and engineering methods from public literature, not any product's proprietary design.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「物質波馬赫—曾德干涉與重力相位」到「驗證、國際比對與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Matter-wave Mach–Zehnder interferometry and the gravity phase" through "Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
